[[Ashford]] is a small and peaceful village situated within [[Lakeside County]]. It is primarily a farming village that lies just outside [[Ashford Abbey]].

==Notes==
{{gw2w|Ashford Forum}}
*In post-Searing [[Ascalon]], Ashford has been annihilated by several of the many large crystals used by the [[Charr]] in their invasion of Ascalon. A small number of the original buildings remain as scorched foundations, but the rest have been obliterated. Bridges and road surfaces are gone, although most of the dirt roadbeds appear to be intact. The portal to [[Wizard's Folly]] is also gone, and the resurrection shrine has been moved closer to Ashford Abbey, renamed to [[Sardelac Sanitarium]] in post-Searing.
*A [[Red Iris Flower]] always spawns somewhere in the village. Repeatedly zoning in from Ashford Abbey can be used to farm this item.
